narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The pointed tips are the vertex, because they are the sharp parts.
<bookmark mark='tips'/>Watch the tips again. They move apart, and they stand in a new place every time.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The vertex is the place where the arms meet, and that place stays still.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>The arms are the parts that turn, and the vertex is the joint they turn about.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Open a step ladder on the floor. Name its arms and say where the vertex is.
